# Pull Request Checklist

## Purpose
> Describe the purpose of this PR. What system are you implementing? What issue does it fix?

## Dependencies
> List any systems that are impacted by this change.

## Edge Cases Handled
> Did you consider edge cases defined in the design spec? List them here.

## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows `docs/standards/coding_standards.md`
- [ ] Unit tests have been written and pass locally
- [ ] Architecture aligns with the Game Master Bible specs
- [ ] No temporary "TODO" or "FIXME" left in the code
- [ ] AI prompts updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Database schema updated (if applicable)

## Developer Notes
> Any context or notes for the reviewer.
